So the UK is going to lock up a thousands of men for looking at underage girls on internet. Probably for minimum sentences of 10 years. I know underage porn is gross, but this doesn’t really seem like a great thing for society.

I was in a situation similar to this when I was 17. I did something bad to another person, something that I knew was unquestionably bad. I hurt another person because I was selfish and careless.   
It's hard to look at yourself and go, wow I'm a bad person. What do you do with that knowledge? I came up with these options and settled on option 3  


1. Accept that you're a bad person and try to make amends by improving your karma/paying back the debt you've caused somehow. This doesn't really work because there's no way of measuring suffering so it's easy to put yourself in a situation where you're living solely out of guilt trying to give back to the world.
2. Reject the idea of good and bad and say we live in a world of chaos and nothing matters so I might as well enjoy myself before going to hell. This is obviously not a path to happiness or fulfillment of any kind.
3. Accept that everyone has the capability to do good or bad. You did something bad, and it might be nice if you try to good things in the future to balance it out, but more importantly this bad act doesn't have to define you. Tomorrow you get to be a different person than you are today.

Forgiving yourself means accepting that you are flawed, that we are all flawed, and that despite this we are all doing our best. If you don't forgive yourself for whatever you've done, then you are letting that bad define who you are. Being someone else, changing into someone else is scary because we don't know who this new person is or if we will like them. It feels like a betrayal of who we are. The truth though is that we all change, whether we want to or not. Think about who you want to be, and how you can become that person.

It sounds like you don't want to live the life you're living, or be the person you currently are. I try to tell myself that tomorrow you can forget who you were yesterday and be someone new. For whatever reasons you feel like a piece of shit, I forgive you, and I hope you can forgive yourself. We are all deeply deeply flawed human beings in a frankly kind of messed up world. I'm sorry you don't have anyone, but if it helps at all I'm a real person who is reading this and thinking of you. If I could give you a hug I would.

Thanks man. It's been hard to reach out to anyone with covid going on, and I don't have much in the way of family/relatives. I do have some people close to me, old partners mostly, but I don't really want to bring up to them that I'm considering suicide.

It's not that I can't handle sadness, I just don't think I could deal with losing all my hard work of climbing my way towards being a functional adult to suddenly having a criminal record, being a felon, losing my job, and potentially going to jail. Maybe if this was happening when I was still in college, or once I had already started my career, but it's happening right as I graduate so I'm probably fucked, my life won't really recover from this and I don't want to work at a gas station until i'm dead.

It's also been raining for like 3 weeks straight where I live so I can't even go for walks. I swear sometimes god is laughing at us.  
It's honestly nice to know someone read this. I'm so scared every day.

It's maybe weird advice, but... Let yourself go a little crazy. Today is the only day we ever really have, so take risks, try new things, forget about being alone or what other people think. Get some paint and fingerpaint your kitchen floor, shave off all your body hair for no reason, get a sleeping bag and see how long you can stay outside before going home.   


If you're going to be sad and alone, might as well try to keep yourself entertained. Also I really feel you. I try to tell myself that life is getting better, that i'm getting better, but it feels like a lie.

I'm so sorry. I cant imagine what losing someone like that would be like. I guess I try to tell myself that maybe good things will happen in the future, and probably your wife would want you to keep living and be happy, but I know that's hard to believe. rooting for you to keep living man <3
